One of the 9 hymns that are printed in the Stavamaṇimālā as Sarasvatī Vilāsa Series 6 (ed. Subrahmanya Sastri)
107 verses written in Śikhariṇī metre. The hymn enumerates the features of Rāma's chatacter and contains a prayer to Rāma to bestow prasāda (kindness, kṛpā). (see Sinhā 308–310)
